pub fn workspace_manifest() -> &'static str {
    r#"[workspace]
members = [
    \"core\",
    \"cli\",
    \"fuzz\",
    \"bench\",
]
default-members = [
    \"core\",
    \"cli\",
]
"#
}

pub fn default_members_are_runtime_targets_only() -> bool {
    let manifest = workspace_manifest();
    manifest.contains("default-members")
        && !manifest.contains("default-members = [\n    \"fuzz\"")
        && !manifest.contains("default-members = [\n    \"bench\"")
}
